鼻中隔偏曲类型与咽鼓管功能之间的关联：一项前瞻性观察性研究。

Association Between Nasal Septal Deviation Types and Eustachian Tube Function: A Prospective Observational Study.

中文摘要

目的： 本研究旨在客观和主观地评估根据Baumann系统分类的鼻中隔偏曲（NSD）类型对咽鼓管功能的影响。
方法： 共纳入107例NSD患者（78例男性，29例女性；平均年龄：35.39±9.55岁）。根据Baumann分类将NSD分为6种类型。所有患者均完成了NOSE（鼻塞症状评估）量表和ETDQ-7（咽鼓管功能障碍问卷）。使用ETF-1（咽鼓管功能-1）测试评估咽鼓管功能，并评估其与NSD类型的相关性。
结果： 晚期偏曲类型（5型和6型）与较高的NOSE和ETDQ-7评分相关，并且在Toynbee和Valsalva动作期间鼓室压反应显著降低。6型表现出最高的ETDQ-7评分和最低的Pmax-Pmin值。
结论： 晚期鼻中隔偏曲与更差的主观和客观咽鼓管功能指标相关。这些发现可能对晚期鼻中隔偏曲患者的术前评估具有意义。

英文摘要

OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to objectively and subjectively evaluate the effect of nasal septal deviation (NSD) types, classified according to the Baumann system, on Eustachian tube function.
METHODS: A total of 107 NSD patients (78 males, 29 females; mean age: 35.39 ± 9.55 years) were included. NSD was categorized into 6 types based on the Baumann classification. All patients completed the NOSE (Nasal Obstruction Symptom Evaluation) scale and ETDQ-7 (Eustachian Tube Dysfunction Questionnaire). Eustachian tube function was evaluated using the ETF-1 (Eustachian Tube Function-1) test, and correlations with NSD types were evaluated.
RESULTS: Advanced deviation types (Types 5 and 6) were associated with higher NOSE and ETDQ-7 scores and significantly reduced tympanometric pressure responses during both Toynbee and Valsalva maneuvers. Type 6 exhibited the highest ETDQ-7 scores and the lowest Pmax-Pmin values.
CONCLUSION: Advanced nasal septal deviation was associated with worse subjective and objective measures of Eustachian tube function. These findings may be relevant during preoperative assessment of patients with advanced septal deviation.
